# PROCE55US — Prompt a processus. Understand the code.

> PROCE55US is a free, open-source creative-coding atelier and step-by-step AI notebook developed by Gaël Hugo. Each cell in a notebook ("processus") pairs a natural-language prompt (in English or French) with readable, commented, directly editable code in Vanilla JavaScript (2D Canvas), p5.js, three.js (WebGL 3D), or HTML/CSS DOM — rendered live in a sandboxed preview.

## Key Links

- [Official Website](https://proce55us.com/): Product overview, features, 4-step workflow, setup guide, and macOS downloads (English & French).
- [Live Web Editor](https://editor.proce55us.com/): Run PROCE55US directly in the browser with local LM Studio or cloud API keys.
- [Source Code Repository](https://github.com/gaelhugo/ECAL_MID_1_2027/tree/main/Tools/AgentCodingWithLMStudio): Open-source repository (Vanilla JS + Vite + Electron macOS build).
- [Latest macOS Universal DMG](https://github.com/gaelhugo/ECAL_MID_1_2027/releases/latest/download/proce55us-universal.dmg): Universal macOS desktop app (Apple Silicon & Intel, macOS 12+).
- [One-Line macOS Terminal Installer](https://proce55us.com/install): `curl -fsSL https://proce55us.com/install | sh`
- [Homebrew Tap](https://github.com/gaelhugo/homebrew-proce55us): `brew install --cask gaelhugo/proce55us/proce55us`

## Why PROCE55US? (Pedagogical & Creative Coding Philosophy)

- **Step-by-step decomposition ("Processus"):** Instead of generating an opaque, monolithic script from a single chat prompt, PROCE55US breaks creative coding projects into sequential steps. Each step adds or refines one visual, structural, or interactive behavior.
- **Readable & editable code:** Generated code is structured, commented in the user's language (English or French), and immediately editable inside each cell.
- **Incremental `<script>` replay architecture:** Each step runs in its own `<script>` tag inside a sandboxed preview iframe in notebook order. Top-level variables (`const` / `let`) are declared once; evolving behaviors are written as functions that later steps can override. When prompting a cell, the model receives all preceding active cells plus an automatic `ProgramSummary` of defined functions.
- **Round-trip standalone HTML export:** Every sketch can be downloaded as a single self-contained `.html` file (embedding a `<script id="proce55us" type="application/json">` manifest). Dragging and dropping that `.html` (or `.json`) file back into PROCE55US restores all prompt and code cells for continued editing.

## Four Creative Coding Modes

1. **JavaScript (`vanilla`, default):** Standard HTML5 2D Canvas API drawing, pixel manipulation, webcam/audio reactive visuals, and animation loops.
2. **p5.js (`p5`, v1.11.13):** Processing's spirit for the web (`setup()`, `draw()`, 2D/WebGL shapes, typography, noise, and interaction).
3. **three.js (`three`, r186):** 3D WebGL scenes (`window.THREE` and `THREE.OrbitControls` preloaded — meshes, lights, cameras, materials, shaders).
4. **DOM (`dom`):** Full web page manipulation with HTML elements, CSS (`css()` helper), kinetic typography, and interactive layouts.

## Supported AI Models & Providers

- **Local & Offline (Default — Recommended):** [LM Studio](https://lmstudio.ai) running locally on `http://localhost:1234` (OpenAI-compatible API). Works offline with any open-weight or open-source coding model chosen by the user.
- **Cloud Providers (Free tiers supported):**
  - Google Gemini (Google AI Studio API key)
  - Groq (GroqCloud API key)
  - Cerebras (Cerebras Cloud API key)
  - OpenRouter (OpenRouter API key)

## Résumé en français

PROCE55US (https://proce55us.com/?lang=fr · éditeur web : https://editor.proce55us.com/) est un atelier de creative coding open source conçu par Gaël Hugo. Il permet de créer et comprendre du code étape par étape (« processus ») en associant des prompts en langage naturel (français ou anglais) à du code modifiable en JavaScript (Canvas 2D), p5.js, three.js (WebGL 3D) ou DOM (HTML/CSS), avec aperçu en direct, IA locale via LM Studio (avec n'importe quel modèle open source au choix de l'utilisateur) ou clés API cloud gratuites, et export/réouverture en fichier HTML autonome par glisser-déposer.
